name: Orbit AI - CRM Architecture - Deals Desk company/contract lookup (new, supports the Deals Desk UI)

nodes.name: Deals Desk lookup webhook
nodes.notes: New this pass, built to support the Deals Desk UI (command-center's /deals-desk page). Input: {searchTerm?} for a name search returning a list, OR {companyId?} for one company's full detail (including its active Contract) - contract-amendment-flow.workflow.json's own notes have said since it was built that it's 'meant to be called by a rep action (Deals Desk, not built)' - this workflow is the read side that makes that rep action possible; contract-amendment-flow.workflow.json itself is the write side, unchanged.

nodes.name: Fetch Company by ID
nodes.notes: Detail path - one specific Company, by ID, once a rep has picked one from search results.

nodes.name: Fetch active Contract
nodes.notes: Same query health-scoring.workflow.json's 'Fetch active Contract' node uses - the Contract row this Company's amendment (if any is submitted next) will supersede. A Company with no active Contract (shouldn't normally happen for a LiveClient, but not assumed impossible) comes back as an empty list, handled in 'Build detail response' below rather than treated as an error.

nodes.name: Fetch LiveClient Companies
nodes.notes: Search path - same query health-scoring.workflow.json/cx-cadence.workflow.json/pipeline-reporting-digest.workflow.json all use. Whole-table fetch, filtered client-side (next node) - same 'Twenty CRM's real filter support for a fuzzy name search isn't confirmed' discipline as every other list fetch in this repo; a name-substring server-side filter would be strictly better once confirmed possible.
